main_text.p: גזז Refecuit, Abfcidit, Totondit: Part. כִּי גָּזַז Quòd tonderet, 1.Sam.25.4. Plur. גֹּזִים Tondentes, 2.Sam. 13.23. Constr. עַל גֹּזֵי Ad tonsores, Genef.38.12. Niph. Præter. נִגְזוּ Tonsi fuissent, Nah.1.12.

גֵּז m. Vellus, Secta lana, Deuter.18.4. וּמִגֵּז Et de vellere, Job.31.v.20. Item, Secta herba, Psalm.72.6. Plural. Constr. גִּזֵּי Fœnisecia, Amos 7.1. Fœmin. גִּזָּה Vellus, Jud.6.37. Constr. גֵּזֶת הַצֶּמֶר Vellus lana, ibid.

גְּזִית f. Cæsura, Cæsio: Lapis cælus & ferro politus, 1.Reg.5.17. Sic Kimchi illud hûc refert, quasi pro גְּזִית positu, ut dicitur זלל a זָלַל. Alioqui magis esset a גּוּז deducendum. Kimchi in Michlol scribit, esse pro גְּזִיִּית forma גְּפָרִית: Sic vult etiam בְּרִית esse pro בְּרִרִית, & contractum debuisse dagessari, גְּזִית. Sed בְּרִית cū Cholem loco Dagesch.
גזל Rapuit, Abripuit, Diripuit: Præterit. גְּזֹלוֹת גָּזַל Rapinas rapuit, Ezech.18.12. Niph.Præter. וְנִגְזָלָה Et eripitur, Prov.4.16.
גָּזֵל m. Idem: וּגְזַל מִשְׁפָּט Et rapina juris, Eccles.5.7.
גּוֹזָל m. Pullus, avium vel columbarum proprie, quod Rapinæ sit expositus, Genef.15.v.9. Plural.cum Aff. גּוֹזָלָיו Pullos suos, Deut.32.11.
גּוֹזֶלֶת fœm. Raptum, Rapina, Levit.6.4. Construct. גְּזֵלַת הֶעָנִי Rapina pauperis, Jesa.3.14. Plural. גּוֹזָלוֹת Ezech.18.12.
גּוֹזָם m. Eruca, Joel.1.4. Aben Esra à גָּזַז Tonden-do, deducit, & מ servile esse vult.
גָּזַע m. Truncus succisus, Jesa.11.1. Aff. גִּזְעוֹ Truncus succisus ejus, Job.14.8.
גָּזַר Secuit, Scidit, Abscidit: Decidit, Decrevit: Præt. גָּזַר Abscinderet, scil. hostis, vel Abscinderetur, Hab.

page.notes: Large Hebrew root letters at the left of the entries (גזז, גזל, גזם, גזע, גזר) are printed in heavy type and are copied as part of their entries. The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are small and at the limit of legibility; the vocalised forms are transcribed as seen and may contain errors in the diacritics. Word forms in the top line of the entry for גזל and in the constructs of the Latin glosses are the least certain. Printed "Ezech.18.12." after the plural form of גוזלות is copied as printed. No marginal notes on this page.
